column1: # Every rerere resolution this fork has moved aside, and why.
# A recorded resolution is not a one-time mistake: rerere replays it on every
# rebuild and reports the merge clean, so a wrong entry is an institutionalised
# one. These failed the audit in .fork/lib/rr-audit.sh.
# QUARANTINED, NOT DELETED. The live copy is at
# QUARANTINE_REASON.txt beside it. Restoring one is a mv, then delete its row
# Removing an entry from .fork/rr-cache does NOT stop it replaying: import
# never overwrites a live entry, so the committed cache and $GITDIR/rr-cache
# have to be cleaned SEPARATELY. Quarantine does both.
